summary: Same grill re-recorded after widening write_scope with apps/core/src/app (worker signal S-0001-62c1: ChannelOpts gains resolvePersonIdentity, injected from the app bootstrap wiring - anticipated by the exploration). Content otherwise unchanged.
gaps: Reconcile silently skips approvers who aren't message-ingested participants - a fresh group's seed would no-op.
Recognition via alias alone is too loose (aliases auto-mint for group speakers).
Retired aliases throw from resolve instead of returning unresolved.
A second join event could re-seed and clobber a configured approver list.
seedInstaller must not fork a second settings-write path (semantic-merge risk with register).
Widened app scope could invite unrelated bootstrap edits.
resolutions: AC2: installer upserted as conversation participant at seed time (join event = membership evidence); reconcile check untouched; test pins reconcile survival.
AC3: recognised requires the new hasDirectConversationWithPerson query in addition to alias resolution.
AC3: the throw is caught and mapped to unrecognised (fail-closed).
AC4: already-registered bail + onboarding-row dedup + preserve-on-empty pinned by the dedup test.
seedInstaller is EXTRACTED from register (one shared block), not copied.
The app-scope delta is one injection point (resolvePersonIdentity onto ChannelOpts in channel wiring); the stage-done diff measure keeps it honest.
